2608.26958.title: Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable
2608.26958.paper_summary: Scaling model-generated data is usually viewed as improving distillation: more examples should increase coverage, reduce noise, and produce stronger students. We show a second effect: larger datasets can make subtle teacher-specific signals easier to detect in the trained student, even when examples are off-task and never mention the trait. In a controlled setup inspired by subliminal learning, a teacher induced to express a target trait generates restricted off-task data, such as number-only completions. Students trained on different amounts of independent off-task data are evaluated in a separate domain, with matched no-trait controls isolating target-specific transfer. Our main finding is that larger independent datasets make the teacher's induced trait stand out more clearly in the student's later behavior. Other plausible traits may also strengthen with scale, but the target usually grows more. When the small-scale student already favors the target, scaling mainly amplifies that behavior; when it favors a related or salient alternative, more data can shift behavior toward the intended trait. Analyses of learned LoRA updates show a parallel trend. These effects appear across model families, trait types, multi-trait settings, and cross-model transfer. Our results suggest that scaling generated distillation data should be paired with trait-aware curation and evaluation, even when the data appears off-task or benign.
2608.26958.paper_summary_zh: 擴展模型生成的數據通常被視為改善蒸餾：更多的範例應該能增加覆蓋範圍、減少噪音，並產生更強的學生。我們顯示了第二個效果：更大的數據集可以使微妙的教師特定信號在訓練後的學生中更容易被檢測到，即使範例是偏離任務的，並且從未提及該特徵。在一個受潛意識學習啟發的控制設置中，一位教師被引導表達一個目標特徵，生成限制性的偏離任務數據，例如僅包含數字的完成。接受不同數量獨立偏離任務數據訓練的學生在一個單獨的領域中進行評估，並且匹配的無特徵對照組隔離了目標特定的轉移。我們的主要發現是，更大的獨立數據集使得教師引導的特徵在學生後期行為中更加明顯。其他合理的特徵在擴展時也可能增強，但目標通常增長得更多。當小規模的學生已經偏好目標時，擴展主要放大該行為；當他們偏好相關或顯著的替代品時，更多的數據可以將行為轉向預期的特徵。對學習的LoRA更新的分析顯示出類似的趨勢。這些效果在模型家族、特徵類型、多特徵設置和跨模型轉移中均有出現。我們的結果表明，擴展生成的蒸餾數據應與特徵感知的策劃和評估相結合，即使數據看起來是偏離任務或良性的。
